name: Chill with Lisa – She Listens, She Cares, She Supports
source:
Lisa is here to listen. Choose what’s on your mind, and she’ll help you see things differently. This visual novel is a cozy space where you can relax, get support, and hear kind words. Sometimes, all you need is someone who truly understands.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555670/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
丽莎在这里聆听。选择你的想法，她会帮助你以不同的方式看待事物。这本视觉小说是一个舒适的空间，你可以在这里放松、获得支持并听到善意的话语。有时候，你需要的只是一个真正懂你的人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555670/]Steam[/url]]
